name: hound-grounded-surge
description: hound-grounded.json replayed at the SURGE pace (?pace=surge&hound=1): the same floor route and the same single terrain jump, against surge's ramping edge, no-dwell contacts, and chained launches. Pairs with hound-jump-surge.json. Proves the floor-denial counterplay is a property of the enemy, not of one pacing variant — the telegraph has to survive the pace the operator may actually pick.
